_note: Voice casting for The Knot Clerk (1st person, present tense: Ila Brandt). Ila's own lines stay on the narrator voice (gemini.voices c-ila-brandt = "narrator"). gemini.narrator overrides config/tts.json gemini.narrator. In S01E001 Cuthbert Oake appears as Mr Pargeter (his alias), so those lines use Cuthbert's voice. Voices kept distinct from down-is-where-i-say. lexicon: Kokoro IPA; respell: Gemini only. Cast 2026-11-13, not yet approved by Ben.

respell._note: Gemini only: words replaced in the text sent to Gemini.

narrator.style: Earnest, eager, warm young British woman telling her own story in the present tense, a clerk on her first field job; bright and over-friendly, never dry or ironic; quicker and higher when excited or frightened; natural pace with clear pauses between paragraphs

c-cuthbert-oake.style: Courtly, gentle older British gentleman; cultured voice a little worn, like a good coat out in a lot of weather; mild, amused, unhurried

c-orla-treadgold.style: Blunt older British woman, a gardener; short sentences with long pauses; teaches by asking questions

c-mags-danquah.style: Brisk British union shop steward; warm underneath, firm and final, never sentimental

c-ferdie-lusk.style: Fast, cheerful young British man who talks in times and routes; goes quiet and careful at the word luck

c-gervase-vosper.style: Warm, generous, salesman-smooth British man; friendly and precise; never raises his voice

c-honoria-tregear.style: Soft, exact, formal British woman of authority; polite and cool; no contractions

c-aurel-brandt.style: Gentle, terse older British man, a bicycle mender; quiet and fond
